text:
Type: white tie-top curtains, pair
Use: filtering daylight and adding privacy at a window; living room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, coastal, farmhouse
Materials: lightweight woven cotton-look fabric, fabric ties at the top, sheer upper band
Colors: white
Shape: two full-length straight panels hung by knotted ties over the rod, slightly translucent band near the top, soft relaxed folds, light and airy
Feel: airy, fresh, gentle, romantic
Goes with: white walls, light wood, linen bedding, soft pastels; Scandinavian, coastal or cottage rooms

product.name: PRLBLAD
product.description: The curtains lower the general light level and provide privacy by preventing people outside from seeing directly into the room.
